name: WC Affiliate – A Complete WooCommerce Affiliate Plugin
author: Codexpert, Inc

sections.description:
Planning to launch a full-fledged affiliate marketing programs for your WooCommerce store?

You’ve come to the right place and are probably looking at the best solution available for affiliate marketing of your WooCommerce store.

💡 WooCommerce Affiliate Plugin

Launching an affiliate program alongside your traditional marketing efforts is likely to give you extraordinary sales growth if done properly. Using WC Affiliate, you can launch a WordPress affiliate program on your WooCommerce-based store within minutes without hiring a developer or marketer!

So onboard an infinite number of affiliates, let them do marketing for you, and enjoy boosted sales with WC Affiliate.

🤗 Why Use WC Affiliate?

WC Affiliate isn’t just another WordPress affiliate marketing plugin. It compiles everything you need to run a profitable WooCommerce affiliate marketing programme.

  • Exclusively built for running full-featured WooCommerce affiliate programs.
  • Powerful, accurate, and bug-free WooCommerce affiliate management solution.
  • User-friendly interface and an easy-to-use experience.
  • Excellent graphical presentation of the statistics of WP affiliate programs.
  • Comprehensive documentation answers all usability questions.
  • Friendly and dedicated customer support teamon standby 24/7.
  • Automated payout system using PayPal and Stripe for easy payment to the affiliates.

Have any confusion? Feel free to contact our support or visit our website.

👉 WC Affiliate Features – Maximize Your Growth Potential

WC Affiliate is a cleanly coded, powerful plugin aimed at easy affiliate management for your WooCommerce store. It has all the necessary features such as affiliate performance tracking, short link generation, email message customization, cross-domain cookie sharing, banner building, multi-level commission setting, excellent graphical presentation, automatic payout to affiliates, etc. Detailed overview in 👇-

✔️ Referral Marketing

WC Affiliate accurately tracks affiliate referrals on your WooCommerce store. You can set any length of cookie/ banner/ coupons validity duration using this affiliate management plugin. A longer cookie expiry length is likely to inspire affiliates to sign up for your affiliate marketing program.

This referral marketing software lets you choose if a new referral should replace the old one. It also helps turn visits into sales more often and grows your store’s traffic and profits.

✔️ Limitless Affiliates

You can onboard as many affiliates as you want using this WooCommerce affiliate plugin. This army of affiliates might bring unimaginable sales volume to your WordPress affiliate program.

✔️ Excellent Reporting

Real-time reporting of referred visits will inform you what’s happening with the affiliate marketing programme, including top affiliates. The report includes detailed information on visits, referrals, affiliates, transactions, and much more.

WC Affiliate reporting uses clear graphs, charts, and tables, making it easy to understand and compare data at a glance. From the summary view, both the Admin and the affiliates can view visits, referrals, conversions, earnings, and top-performing affiliates and web links in a colorful histogram, pie charts, linear graphs, and tables.

✔️ Fixed or Percentage Commission

Not all the affiliates are willing to accept the same type of affiliate commission set by you. That’s why you may need to set different types (e.g., fixed or percentage) of commission as per the business strategy. WC Affiliate offers settings for both of these types for maximum convenience.

On top of these, it also allows you to set different amounts of commissions for different affiliates. This way, you can structure your whole WC affiliate programme to meet your specific needs.

✔️ Personalized Email Messages

Customizing the email messages makes affiliate management more personalized. You can edit the message to be given and address your affiliates by name while communicating with them.

✔️ Payment Method Integrated (PRO)

Integrating payment methods into the WooCommece affiliate program can remove the hassle of offline payments. WC Affiliate can be seamlessly integrated with PayPal and Stripe. Affiliates can request a payout, and you can easily disburse them via these payment methods.

✔️ Translation Ready

Translating your WooCommerce affiliate program is important, as you might get affiliates from various countries and languages when the affiliate marketing is operated internationally. WC Affiliate is translation-ready, meaning it will seamlessly correspond to any translation plugin. You can use popular translation plugins like Loco Translate to translate your WooCommerce affiliate program.

✔️ CSV Export+Import

Your affiliate marketing might include information that you need to share with others or store for further analysis or presentation. For that, WC Affiliate offers an option to download all the affiliates’ data in CSV file format. You can also import data from other platforms if you want to migrate or work with customized user data.

✔️ Banner Builder (PRO)

As a business owner, you need to run sales promotions or discount offers often on your WooCommerce affiliate program. For that, you can easily create web banners and invite your affiliates to use those. Affiliates can use those banners on any website – be that a WordPress site or not.

✔️ Shortlink Generator (PRO)

WC Affiliate makes affiliate management easier by giving you control to allow affiliates to generate short links so that they can share a smart, likable link with their audience. Affiliates, in that case, can generate an unlimited number of short links and can use custom strings during affiliate marketing. Here is an example:

  • Long link: https://codexpert.io/wc-affiliate/?ref=123
  • Shortlink: https://codexpert.io/go/wca

✔️ Cross-Domain Cookie Sharing (PRO)

WC Affiliate enables the affiliates to share the affiliate URL of one site and track it on another, allowing them to use one nice URL instead of many long URLs. It helps the admins better manage affiliates by connecting multiple sites and bringing them all into a single affiliate solution.

✔️ Multilevel Affiliates (PRO)

Gain exponential business growth from the army of affiliates you have with WC Affiliate multilevel commission! The most popular Multilevel Marketing concept is applied in this WooCommerce affiliate plugin. Affiliates will have their affiliates, and then 2nd-level affiliates will have theirs. This can go on up to the level the business owner/admin predetermines.

Admin can set as many levels as they want with different commission amounts/percentages at each level. Setting up these levels will ensure perfect commission distribution and bring exponential growth to your affiliate marketing programs

📍 Connect with our official Facebook page or official Facebook group to get the latest updates and deal announcements.
📝 Go through the documentation for better usability of the WC Affiliate.
💰 Grow with us by joining our affiliate program and earn up to 25% commission on your sales. 💸

sections.installation:
1. Install WC Affiliate using the native Plugin installer, or download the zip and extract it in the wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’
  3. Go to WC Affiliate from the left navigation menu and configure.
  4. Start making more money.

Please reach out to us if you need any help.
sections.faq:
What is WC Affiliate?

WC Affiliate is a feature-rich WooCommerce affiliate marketing plugin that helps store owners create and manage a full-fledged affiliate WooCommerce program effortlessly.

How does WC Affiliate work?

It allows store owners to recruit affiliates, track referrals through unique links, and pay commissions when a sale is made through an affiliate’s referral.

Do I need coding knowledge to use WC Affiliate?

No, WC Affiliate is beginner-friendly and does not require any coding or technical skills to affiliate WooCommerce stores.

Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes, you need to have WooCommerce activated on your site.

Is it possible to apply discounts for the visitors?

Yes, WC Affiliate lets your affiliates apply discounts on their referral links. You need to enable discounts from the Basic settings in order to let your users apply discounts on their affiliate links.

Does WC Affiliate support multi-level marketing (MLM)?

Yes! You can create multi-tier affiliate levels and reward commissions at different stages. It is only available on WC Affiliate Pro.

Can I customize affiliate commissions?

Yes, you can set commissions as fixed amounts or percentages and customize them for different affiliates or products.

Can my affiliates create custom short links?

Yes, with WC Affiliate, users can create custom referral links within seconds. You can choose from random short links or user-defined short links as well.

Can I send custom emails to my affiliates?

Yes, WC Affiliate has the option to customize all the emails to keep your users updated. You can set your own message for Affiliate request, approved, rejection, payout request, etc., through the Email tab within the Basic Settings.

Is WC Affiliate Costly?

Absolutely not. WC Affiliate- the leading affiliate marketing software offers free affiliate program management through its free version. Some advanced features require availing the pro version.
